pages.title: Loom-stitchers
pages.text:
The Loom-stitchers cut the gate-paths — into the March, into the Nether and End, into places the map does not have words for — and always meant to come back and mend them.

They did not get to. You will.

pages.title: Spindle Strand
pages.text:
*The Loom was never one thread. It was nine agreeing.*

Seated. The Loom-stitchers answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text:
The Loom-stitchers keep a camp in the March crystal fields, at the Crystal Spire: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, a Loom totem, a banner, four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver — and a Loom Anchor.

Their hearth favours March Crystal, Loom Thread, compasses. Their Elder trades Loom Thread at Friend, a Horizon Compass at Kin, and the Loom Anchor. At Voice standing they press the tribe's Mark into your hand. Camps already generated in an old world keep the layout they spawned with.
